title: Vietnam Family Voyage
headline: Hanoi, Halong Bay, Da Nang and a night in Hoi An.
description: A seven-day family circuit: capital streets, an overnight bay cruise, then Central Vietnam’s beaches and lantern town.
image_alt: Tropical beach and clear water along the Vietnamese coast
price_guidance: Indicative from twin sharing with children as quoted. International flights and visa fees sit outside this figure unless you ask us to ticket them.
overview: A north-to-centre family holiday with a night on Halong Bay. Two nights in Hanoi ease everyone in, the cruise breaks the cities, then Da Nang and Hoi An close the week with beach time and a lantern evening children remember.
highlights: Overnight Halong Bay cruise included in the suggested circuit.
Hanoi with space for a water-puppet show or a lake walk.
Da Nang beaches and a day that can include Ba Na Hills.
A night in Hoi An for the lantern streets after dark.
why: Cities, a night at sea and a beach town without a two-week itinerary.
Hotel rooms and transfers planned for families, not only couples.
Daily load can be lightened for younger children.
inclusions: Accommodation on twin or family-room sharing as quoted
Overnight Halong Bay cruise with selected meals
Domestic flight Hanoi–Da Nang, once ticketed
exclusions: Optional Ba Na Hills or Golden Bridge tickets unless added
Personal expenses, GST and tourism fees

stay.name: Selected family-friendly hotels and a Halong Bay cabin

notes: Cabin type, hotel category and optional hill or park tickets are confirmed in writing. Cruise operations depend on weather. An inquiry is not a booking.
